title: PCSO donates food packs, mobility aids, medical devices for Bicol senior citizens

blocks.text: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) provided ChariTimba food packs, mobility aids, and medical devices to the National Commission of Senior Citizens (NCSC) Bicol Region during a turnover ceremony held on October 14, 2026, at the PCSO Main Office in Mandaluyong City. PCSO Executive Assistant Atty. Maria Katrina Nicole Contacto-Ventanilla formally turned over the donations to NCSC Commissioner for Bicol Region Leo Intia and Executive Assistant Lexine Estrada. The assistance is intended to support senior citizens, particularly those facing mobility challenges and limited access to essential healthcare resources.
